units.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 12. Before the service contract is terminated in connection with transfer to another state body, the civil servant may withdraw their application or consent at any time.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 13. A civil servant who is subject to an internal service inquiry or an investigation into compliance with restrictions and prohibitions, requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, and the fulfilment of duties established for the purpose of combating corruption by the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’, the Federal Law ‘On Combating Corruption’, other federal laws and this Law may not be transferred to another civil service position in the same state body (except a transfer, in the cases specified in points 3-6, 9, 10, 13 and 14 of part 5 of this Article, to a position whose position salary does not exceed that of the position currently held) or to another state body.
units.label: Part 13 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 26. Amendment of the terms of a service contract in connection with a change in the conditions of professional service activities
units.text: Article 26. Amendment of the terms of a service contract in connection with a change in the conditions of professional service activities
units.label: Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Amendment of the terms of a service contract in connection with a change in the conditions of professional service activities
units.text: 1. If changes in a civil servant's professional service conditions make it impossible to retain the service contract terms, those terms may be changed on the employer's representative's initiative, with the civil servant's written consent, without changing the civil servant's official duties.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Amendment of the terms of a service contract in connection with a change in the conditions of professional service activities
units.text: 2. Reasons for changes in professional service conditions entailing changes to service contract terms without changes to official duties include:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Amendment of the terms of a service contract in connection with a change in the conditions of professional service activities
units.text: 1) inclusion of the position held in the list of civil service positions subject to rotation, or removal of the position from that list;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Amendment of the terms of a service contract in connection with a change in the conditions of professional service activities
units.text: 2) relocation to another locality of the state body or its structural subdivision in which the civil servant holds a position;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Amendment of the terms of a service contract in connection with a change in the conditions of professional service activities
units.text: 3) changes to remuneration terms in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Amendment of the terms of a service contract in connection with a change in the conditions of professional service activities
units.text: 4) changes to the legislation of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Amendment of the terms of a service contract in connection with a change in the conditions of professional service activities
units.text: 5) amendment of the service contract terms provided for by point 6 of part 2 of Article 20 of this Law.
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Amendment of the terms of a service contract in connection with a change in the conditions of professional service activities
units.text: 3. The employer's representative must notify the civil servant in writing of forthcoming changes to the service contract terms and the reasons for them at least two months before they take effect, except for the changes provided for by points 3 and 4 of part 2 of this Article.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Amendment of the terms of a service contract in connection with a change in the conditions of professional service activities
units.text: 4. If a civil servant does not agree to continue state service relations in the current position because changes in professional service conditions entail changes to the service contract, other than the changes in points 3 and 4 of part 2 of this Article, and the state body has other vacant civil service positions retaining those professional service conditions, the employer's representative must offer those vacancies in writing against acknowledgement of receipt, taking account of the category and group of the current position, provided that the civil servant meets the qualification requirements for the position.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Amendment of the terms of a service contract in connection with a change in the conditions of professional service activities
units.text: 5. If a civil servant refuses in writing to continue state service relations in the civil service position held because of changes in professional service conditions entailing amendment of the service contract terms as provided for by points 3 and 4 of part 2 of this Article, the service contract is terminated in accordance with point 7 of part 1 of Article 33 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Amendment of the terms of a service contract in connection with a change in the conditions of professional service activities
units.text: 6. If a civil servant refuses in writing another civil service position offered because of changes in professional service conditions entailing amendment of the service contract terms, or if no such position is available in the same state body, the service contract is terminated in accordance with point 7 of part 1 of Article 33 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 27. Temporary filling of another civil service position
units.text: Article 27. Temporary filling of another civil service position
units.label: Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Temporary filling of another civil service position
units.text: 1. In the event of service necessity, the employer’s representative may transfer a civil servant for up to one month to a civil service position in the same state body not specified in the service contract, with monetary remuneration for the position temporarily held, but no less than the established average wage for the position previously held. Such transfer is permitted to prevent a catastrophe, industrial accident or natural disaster, to remedy their consequences, to prevent accidents, temporary suspension of professional service activities for economic, technological, technical or organizational reasons, or destruction of or damage to property, and to replace a temporarily absent civil servant. A civil servant may not, however, be transferred to another civil service position contraindicated by their state of health.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Temporary filling of another civil service position
units.text: 2. Transfer to replace a temporarily absent civil servant may not exceed one month in a calendar year.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Temporary filling of another civil service position
units.text: 3. By agreement of the parties, the employer’s representative may appoint a civil servant to a civil service position not specified in the service contract that was previously held by a temporarily absent civil servant, including a position in a higher group, with the position salary for the position temporarily held, but no less than the position salary for the position previously held, payment of the allowances established for the position temporarily held, and provision of state social guarantees. By agreement of the parties, the civil servant may retain the civil service position previously held.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 28. Relations connected with the civil service in the event of a reduction of civil service positions or the abolition of a state body
units.text: Article 28. Relations connected with the civil service in the event of a reduction of civil service positions or the abolition of a state body
units.label: Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Relations connected with the civil service in the event of a reduction of civil service positions or the abolition of a state body
units.text: 1. Upon reduction of civil service positions or abolition of a state body, state service relations continue if the civil servant holding a position being reduced or a position in the body being abolished is offered, with their written consent, another civil service position in the same state body, in the state body receiving the abolished body's functions, or in another state body, taking account of:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Relations connected with the civil service in the event of a reduction of civil service positions or the abolition of a state body
units.text: 1) their professional level, specialty, field of training, and length of civil service or work experience in the specialty or field of training; 2) their level of professional education and length of civil service or work experience in the specialty or field of training, provided they receive additional professional education corresponding to the field and type of professional service activities of the position offered.
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Relations connected with the civil service in the event of a reduction of civil service positions or the abolition of a state body
units.text: 2. A civil servant holding a position being reduced or a position in a state body being abolished is personally notified by the employer's representative, against acknowledgement of receipt, of the forthcoming dismissal due to reduction of positions or abolition of the body at least two months before dismissal.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Relations connected with the civil service in the event of a reduction of civil service positions or the abolition of a state body
units.text: 3. During the period specified in part 2 of this Article, an extraordinary appraisal of civil servants may be conducted in the state body in accordance with Article 37 of this Law. On the basis of that appraisal, civil servants with a preferential right to hold a civil service position may be offered other civil service positions, including in another state body.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Relations connected with the civil service in the event of a reduction of civil service positions or the abolition of a state body
units.text: 4. A preferential right to hold a civil service position is given to a civil servant with a higher professional level, a specialty and field of training corresponding to the field and type of their professional service activity, longer civil service or work experience in the specialty or field of training, and better results of professional service activity.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Relations connected with the civil service in the event of a reduction of civil service positions or the abolition of a state body
units.text: 5. Within two months after notifying a civil servant of dismissal, the employer's representative of the state body reducing civil service positions, or of the state body receiving the functions of an abolished body, must offer the civil servant holding a position being reduced or a position in the abolished body all vacant civil service positions available in the same body or the body receiving those functions, respectively, taking account of the category and group of the current position, the civil servant's professional level, specialty, field of training, and length of civil service or work in the specialty or field of training. If no such positions exist in those bodies, the representative may offer vacancies in other state bodies in the manner determined by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Relations connected with the civil service in the event of a reduction of civil service positions or the abolition of a state body
units.text: 6. If, upon reduction of civil service positions or abolition of a state body, a civil servant refuses another civil service position offered, including in another state body, the civil servant is released from the position held and dismissed from the civil service. In this case, the service contract is terminated, upon reduction of civil service positions, in accordance with point 8(2) of part 1 of Article 37 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’, and, upon abolition of a state body, in accordance with point 8(3) of part 1 of Article 37 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Relations connected with the civil service in the event of a reduction of civil service positions or the abolition of a state body
units.text: 7. With the civil servant's written consent, the employer's representative may terminate the service contract before the period specified in part 2 of this Article expires, paying additional compensation equal to retained monetary remuneration calculated proportionately to the time remaining until expiry of the dismissal notice period.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 29. Suspension from a civil service position held
units.text: Article 29. Suspension from a civil service position held
units.label: Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Suspension from a civil service position held
units.text: 1. The employer’s representative must temporarily suspend from the civil service position held (not permit to perform official duties) a civil servant:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Suspension from a civil service position held
units.text: 1) who reports for service under the influence of alcohol, narcotic drugs or other toxic substances;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Suspension from a civil service position held
units.text: 2) who has not undergone the prescribed training and assessment of knowledge and skills in protection of professional service activity (occupational safety);
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Suspension from a civil service position held
units.text: 3) at the request of bodies or officials authorized by federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Suspension from a civil service position held
units.text: 2. This part was repealed with effect from 21 February 2020 by Law of the City of Moscow of 29 January 2020 No. 2.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Suspension from a civil service position held
units.text: 3. The employer's representative may suspend a civil servant from the position held (not permit performance of official duties) for the period of:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Suspension from a civil service position held
units.text: 1) resolution of a conflict of interest;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Suspension from a civil service position held
units.text: 2) verification of:
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Suspension from a civil service position held
units.text: а) the accuracy and completeness of information on income, property and property-related obligations and information on expenditure submitted by the civil servant in accordance with the Federal Law ‘On Combating Corruption’ and other federal laws; б) information submitted by the civil servant upon entry into the civil service in accordance with regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 2 Part 3 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Suspension from a civil service position held
units.text: в) the civil servant’s compliance with restrictions and prohibitions and requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, and fulfilment of duties established by the Federal Law ‘On Combating Corruption’, other federal laws and this Law.
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 2 Part 3 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Suspension from a civil service position held
units.text: 3) an internal service inquiry in accordance with Article 48 of this Law.
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Suspension from a civil service position held
units.text: 3.1. In the cases specified in part 3 of this Article, a civil servant may be suspended from the civil service position held (not permitted to perform official duties) for no more than 60 days from the decision to resolve the conflict of interest or conduct the investigation. This period may be extended to 90 days by the person who took the relevant decision. The civil servant retains monetary remuneration for the entire period of suspension from the position held (performance of official duties).
units.label: Part 3.1 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Suspension from a civil service position held
units.text: 4. The employer’s representative suspends a civil servant from the civil service position held (does not permit performance of official duties) for the entire period until the circumstances constituting the grounds for suspension from the position held (non-admission to performance of official duties) have been eliminated.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Suspension from a civil service position held
units.text: 5. A civil servant suspended from the civil service position held may not be appointed to another civil service position.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Suspension from a civil service position held
units.text: 6. During suspension of a civil servant from the civil service position held (non-admission to performance of official duties) on any of the grounds provided for by part 1 of this Article, monetary remuneration is not retained. During suspension of a civil servant from the position held (non-admission to performance of official duties) on any of the grounds provided for by part 3 of this Article, monetary remuneration for the civil service position held is retained for the period of suspension.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 30. Grounds for release from a civil service position held, termination of a service contract and/or dismissal from the civil service
units.text: Article 30. Grounds for release from a civil service position held, termination of a service contract and/or dismissal from the civil service
units.label: Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Grounds for release from a civil service position held, termination of a service contract and/or dismissal from the civil service
units.text: 2. Release from a civil service position held, termination of a service contract and dismissal from the civil service are formalized by an act of a state body.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Grounds for release from a civil service position held, termination of a service contract and/or dismissal from the civil service
units.text: 3. On the civil servant’s final day of performing official duties, the employer’s representative must make the final settlement with the civil servant and issue their employment record book or provide employment activity information for the period of civil service in the relevant state body. At the civil servant’s written request, the employer’s representative must also issue other documents connected with civil service and pension provision. Employment activity information is provided by the method specified in the civil servant’s application (on paper, duly certified, or as an electronic document signed with an enhanced qualified electronic signature, if the employer’s representative has one); the application is submitted by the civil servant in writing or sent, in accordance with the procedure established by the employer’s representative, to the employer’s representative’s email address.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Grounds for release from a civil service position held, termination of a service contract and/or dismissal from the civil service
units.text: 4. On the day of release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service, a civil servant must surrender their service identity card to the state body’s personnel service. Chapter 6. Personal data of a civil servant. Personnel service of a state body
units.label: Part 4 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 31. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant’s personnel file
units.text: Article 31. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant’s personnel file
units.label: Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant’s personnel file
units.text: 1. When processing a civil servant's personal data, the personnel service of a state body shall comply with the following requirements:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant’s personnel file
units.text: 1) a civil servant’s personal data are processed in compliance with the Constitution of the Russian Federation, the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data, other federal laws and other regulatory legal acts, for the purposes of assisting the civil servant in civil service, education and career advancement, ensuring the personal safety of the civil servant and their family members and the security of their property, recording the results of the performance of official duties, and ensuring the security of the state body’s property;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant’s personnel file
units.text: 2) personal data are submitted by the civil servant personally. Where necessary, personal data may be obtained from a third party with the civil servant’s written consent;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant’s personnel file
units.text: 3) personal data on a civil servant’s political, religious and other beliefs, private life, or membership of public associations, including trade unions, which are not provided for by federal laws may not be processed or included in the civil servant’s personnel file;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant’s personnel file
units.text: 4) decisions producing legal consequences for a civil servant or otherwise affecting their rights and legitimate interests may not be based on the civil servant's personal data obtained solely as a result of automated processing, except in cases provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant’s personnel file
units.text: 5) protection of a civil servant’s personal data against unlawful use or loss is funded by the state body in accordance with the procedure established by federal laws;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant’s personnel file
units.text: 6) a civil servant’s personal data may not be transferred to a third party without the civil servant’s written consent, except in cases established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data. The conditions and procedure for transferring a civil servant’s personal data to a third party are established by federal regulatory legal acts.
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant’s personnel file
units.text: 2. A civil servant responsible for violating rules governing the processing of another civil servant’s personal data bears liability in accordance with federal laws.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant’s personnel file
units.text: 3. A civil servant’s personal data and other information connected with entry into, performance of and dismissal from the civil service are entered in their personnel file.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant’s personnel file
units.text: 4. The regulation on the personal data of a state civil servant and maintenance of a state civil servant’s personnel file is established by federal regulatory legal acts.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 32. Registers of state civil servants
units.text: Article 32. Registers of state civil servants
units.label: Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Registers of state civil servants
units.text: 1. The employer’s representative maintains the register of state civil servants of the state body.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Registers of state civil servants
units.text: 2. Information from a civil servant’s personnel file is included in the register of state civil servants of the state body and stored in the databases of the City of Moscow’s state information system in the field of civil service, with protection against unauthorized access and copying.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Registers of state civil servants
units.text: 3. A civil servant who has died (been killed), or who has been declared missing or dead by a court decision that has entered into legal force, is removed from the state body’s register of state civil servants on the day following the date of death or the entry into legal force of the court decision.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Registers of state civil servants
units.text: 4. This part was repealed with effect from 11 July 2011 by Law of the City of Moscow of 8 June 2011 No. 24.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Registers of state civil servants
units.text: 5. This part was repealed with effect from 11 July 2011 by Law of the City of Moscow of 8 June 2011 No. 24.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 32
